purpose: Release-safe object template metadata. These entries do not contain game object bytes; export copies donor records from the user's own legal game image.

templates.label: Key
templates.dependencyRisk: External key donor. The source row matches the runtime key by index/XYZ, but the loader changes identity bytes before play. Normal Create Loader BIN should skip this until a selected-add test proves the level can load it.
templates.note: Common locked-chest key donor. Export copies the donor record from the user's own legal game image and forces the loader-transformed key identity bytes captured from runtime.

templates.label: Spring Chest
templates.dependencyRisk: External spring chest donor. This uses the Peace Keepers T70 0x0149 donor. The native-only over-0x000E route, the local-controller runtime-0x01A6 helper route, the extended-special source-0xFF route, the extended-special flag4A-0x10 route, the extended-cluster flag4A-0x10 route, and the rebased extended-cluster route all loaded safely but did not react to flame or charge. The native-00C2 package swap also left the spring chest inert and changed a normal Stone Hill chest's visuals/reward behavior. The T70/T71 pair and shared-cluster pair both displayed two inert Spring Chests while forcing source byte +0x52 to 0x10. The current disposable candidate keeps the shared cluster and preserves the clean Peace Keepers source byte +0x52 = 0xFF.
templates.testedResult: The older Town Square route repeatedly froze or behaved like a normal chest in Stone Hill. Peace Keepers T71 helper/controller candidates, the Peace Keepers T70 runtime-0x01A6 helper candidate, and the T70 extended-special/extended-cluster candidates now boot and appear but still do not trigger spring behavior. Replacing Stone Hill's native 0x00C2 package created a weird colored regular chest that gave a blue gem while the spring chest stayed inert. Appending the Peace Keepers T70/T71 pair displayed two Spring Chests but both stayed inert, including the shared-cluster flag4A-0x10 route. The current guarded candidate tests the same shared cluster with source-native +0x52 = 0xFF.
templates.note: Spring chest donor. Kept out of the normal Add Object list for beta because cross-level Spring Chest imports still misroute reward/effect behavior or crash in Stone Hill. Diagnostic candidate exports can still use this metadata.

templates.label: Key Chest
templates.dependencyRisk: External locked chest donor. The source row matches the runtime unlock chest by index/XYZ, but the loader changes identity bytes and chest visuals/behavior may depend on level-local assets or special data.
templates.testedResult: Direct source-record true-adds were invisible or visually corrupt in Artisans because the actor package was missing or loaded from the wrong WAD area. The exporter now has an isolated Artisans actor-root slot-swap test path for this template.
templates.note: Common locked/unlock chest donor. Export copies the donor record from the user's own legal game image and, for isolated tests, swaps the Peace Keepers actor package into an unused Artisans actor-root slot.
